metadata.proof_size_encoding: bincode 2.0.1 serde legacy encoding, uncompressed; per-entry proof bytes are the sum of individual proof encodings with no container framing
metadata.source_revision: not collected by design (no git metadata)

methodology.fixture_seed_scope: Fixture generation only; the prover retains its own fresh proof randomness.
methodology.process_isolation: Each system/T/repetition is a newly spawned child process; peak RSS therefore belongs to that one worker process.
methodology.candidate_set_reporting: The reported candidate-set size is a structural fixture count: 16 synthetic receipts with the same issuer, policy, and public bucket. It is weak, separate from log leaves, and not a measured deployment anonymity set. The published deterministic fixture seed exposes fixture witnesses, so these benchmarks make no anonymity or privacy demonstration.
baseline_limitations: Direct Spartan baseline APIs do not add the random satisfying-instance fold required for the profile zero-knowledge construction; no zero-knowledge guarantee is claimed for those baselines.
The per-entry baseline lacks authenticated chaining and the secure-receipt start/end composition; it is intentionally cheaper than a secure composition.
methodology.per_entry_baseline_methodology: The per-entry baseline emits T+1 proofs: a combined START plus first STEP proof, generic STEP proofs, and a FINAL proof. Setup creates each distinct shape/key once (two shapes when T=1); raw per-proof setup charges that cost to the first proof using that shape and records zero for reuse.
methodology.extrapolation_policy: A configuration may be skipped only when a smaller completed configuration for the same system yields a measured linear T extrapolation above the 90-minute all-repetitions budget. Such a record is explicitly labeled an estimate and contains no invented measurement metrics.
